literal: "I really don't see how you can do anything there.\r\n"
"Nah, you're too much of a badass to go in there!\r\n"
"%s rises from the dead and keeps fighting!"
"$p decays in your hands, and the contents fall to the ground."
"The remorter moves his hands over your eyes, closing them with a touch.\r\nColors spiral in your sight... You open your eyes, feeling refreshed.\r\n"
"Get outta here, punk, you already have one. "
"The magic flows through you, but nothing else happens.\r\n"
"Lightning starts to show in the sky.\r\n"
"The vampirism in your body is not satiated by mere %s...\r\n"
"How many coins do you wish to split with your group?\r\n"
"$n tries to disarm you but fails and falls flat on $s face!"
"You are incapacitated an will slowly die, if not aided.\r\n"
"$n tells you, 'Sorry, you don't have any mail waiting.'"
"$n shivers and transforms into a werewolf!"
